en.t: After I finished playing the shakuhachi, I would often sink into thought:

units.source_text: 金阁为什么不责备也不阻挠我这种化身，而且默许我的这种化身呢？

en.t: Why did the Golden Pavilion neither reproach nor obstruct this transformation of mine, but instead tacitly permit it?

units.source_text: 另一方面，每每在我企图化身为人生的幸福和快乐的时候，

en.t: On the other hand, whenever I tried to transform myself into the happiness and pleasures of life,

units.source_text: 金阁为什么一次也没有放过我呢？

en.t: why did the Golden Pavilion never let me go, not even once?

units.source_text: 它会立即阻止我的化身，使我还原为我自己，

en.t: It would immediately halt my transformation and restore me to myself,

units.source_text: 难道这不就是金阁的做派吗？

en.t: was that not precisely the way of the Golden Pavilion?

units.source_text: 为什么限于音乐，金阁才容忍我陶醉和忘我呢？

en.t: Why was it only in music that the Golden Pavilion tolerated my intoxication and self-forgetfulness?
